olivia: heads-up — release 2026.03.18 is blocked, packaging step failing in CI when pulling our internal wheel (401).
deploy-bot: promotion aborted — preflight checks failed (job: build/package). See job #7421.
matt: grabbing the logs — build shows `GET https://pypi.internal.redwood/wheels/org/foo-1.2.3.whl -> 401 Unauthorized` and `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`
sasha: I rotated the PyPI token yesterday; did we forget to update the GH Actions secret in the service repo?
taylan: quick check: infra vault has the new token at secret/pypi/internal, but I don't see it referenced in the repo actions config.
matt: confirmed. GH secret expected: `PYPI_INTERNAL_TOKEN` — it's not set in redwood/service-api repo.
olivia: options: 1) push the new token to repo secrets (fast but org approval needed), 2) vendor the wheel into repo for this release (safer), 3) rollback to previous release build.
kevin: we should avoid emergency secret pushes during change window if we can. Vendor the wheel for an immediate unblock and follow up with automated rotation.
pm-ana: product needs this out today. Change window is in ~2h. Vendor approach sounds fastest. Also we need to update release notes to call out the temporary vendor.
sasha: I can push the token but org policy requires a 2nd approver — could be 20–30m to get approved, might miss the window.
devops-bot: ran `gh secret list --repo redwood/service-api` -> missing: PYPI_INTERNAL_TOKEN
matt: I'll open a tiny PR that vendors the wheel under `vendor/wheels/` and pins the setup.py to use local wheel for the package. Minimal change, smoke tests only.
olivia: please tag me on the PR. After merge, re-run CI, then we can request manual promote from deploy-bot for a canary.
deploy-bot: manual promote requested for tag `rc/2026.03.18-v1` by matt. Awaiting passing CI and approvals.
sasha: if PR merges, I'll re-run pipeline. If anything else flakes, we'll fallback to rollback plan: revert to `2026.03.17`.
kevin: follow-up task: add automation to populate GH secret from Vault (with audit) so we don't do manual pushes again.
pm-ana: ping me once the canary is up — I'll update the release notes and notify the beta customers.
olivia: proceeding with vendor approach; holding other releases until we have token automation. Will write a short postmortem after this is closed.
matt: PR opened: #1234 — small vendor + ci fix. Requesting quick reviews.
sasha: reviewing now. :eyes:
